status: TEST 0.3.244: Organizer defaults to the existing resource-management module. A single native checkbox labeled 查找和替换 switches to content search/replace when checked and returns to resource management when unchecked. The checkbox has no custom class, inline style, or dedicated CSS; all appearance is inherited from the active SillyTavern/TauriTavern theme. The previous dual-button selector and its layout CSS are removed. Search-term memory, rule loading, scan/preview/replace, backup/restore, and the lower resource-list selection mechanism are retained. Development source, pinned release source, fallback import package, docs, and tests are synchronized. Automated tests, GitHub Actions, and ST/TT real-device acceptance remain pending.
